Logs

To delete all log entries:

  • Click Clear Log.

To save log entries:

  • Click Save Log.

To see the most recent entries:

  • Click Refresh.

Include in Log

Use these checkboxes to determine which events are included in the log. Checking all options will increase the size of the log so it is a good practice to disable any event logs which aren't really required.

  • Attempted access to blocked sites - If checked, all attempted Internet access to blocked sites will be logged.
  • Connections to the Web-based interface of this Router - If checked, all attempted access to the Graphical User Interface of your Sky Hub will be logged.
  • Router operation (start up, link up, voice status, etc.) - Must be checked to enable any logging to take place.

Syslog

The Logs can be sent to a Syslog server. You can select one of these two options, as required:

  • Disable - Select this if you don't have a Syslog server to send logs to.
  • Send to this Syslog server IPv4 address - If your Syslog server has a fixed IP address, select this option, and enter the IP address of your Syslog server.
  • Send to this Syslog server IPv6 address - If your Syslog server has a fixed IP address, select this option, and enter the IP address of your Syslog server.

When finished editing your logs, select Apply to save your changes.
